info.title: Health Triage Assistant API
info.description:
### Offline-First Health Triage Assistant API

Production-grade RESTful API serving clinical triage evaluation, emergency dispatch, health profile management, and PWA outbox sync.

**Key Architectural Highlights:**
- **Dual Intelligence**: Deterministic rule engine + optional Gemini AI enhancement
- **Multilingual**: BCP 47 language tagging (English `en`, Twi `tw`)
- **Clean Architecture**: Isolated domain models, services, and interface adapters
- **RFC 7807 Errors**: Structured problem details error payloads
